actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Lightning damage.
actions.name: Shock

bonus_actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, one living creature the wisp can see within 5 feet that has 0 Hit Points. Failure: The target dies, and the wisp regains 10 (3d6) Hit Points.
bonus_actions.name: Consume Life

bonus_actions.desc: The wisp and its light have the Invisible condition until the wisp’s Concentration ends on this effect, which ends early immediately after the wisp makes an attack roll or uses Consume Life.
bonus_actions.name: Vanish

traits.desc: The wisp can’t wear or carry anything.
traits.name: Ephemeral

traits.desc: The wisp sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 20 feet.
traits.name: Illumination

traits.desc: The wisp can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
